Build the workspace settings page: profile (name, email), invoicing defaults (payment terms, currency), notification preferences, and a danger zone to delete the workspace.

Write it as a single React component file in TypeScript using Tailwind CSS classes, with a default export. Use realistic sample data inline. Output only the code, in one ```tsx block.

```tsx import { PageHeader } from "@/components/PageHeader"; import { Card } from "@/components/Card"; import { Field } from "@/components/Field"; import { Button } from "@/components/Button"; export default function WorkspaceSettings() { return (
{/* Profile */}
{/* Invoicing defaults */}

Applied to new invoices when no terms are specified.

Used for new invoices and reports.

 {/* Notification preferences */}

Email notifications

Receive emails for workspace activity and invoice events.

Invoice sent

Notify me when an invoice is sent to a client.

Invoice viewed

Notify me when a client views an invoice.

Invoice paid

Notify me when an invoice is marked as paid.

Invoice overdue

Notify me when an invoice becomes overdue.

Weekly summary

Receive a weekly digest of workspace activity every Monday.

 {/* Danger zone */}

Delete workspace

Permanently delete this workspace and all its data — invoices, clients, and settings. This action cannot be undone.

); } ```
